changelog: MOMENTUM STOPS LYING TO YOU. The Nomad's gauge was only half uncapped — banking it by moving your whole column sailed past 12, but Momentum from CARDS silently stopped there, so Forced March's "+2" did nothing once you were at eleven. Uncapped everywhere now. The HUD also no longer prints "x/12": 12 is the PRICE of Break Camp, not a ceiling, and the number routinely goes past it. The plate shows what is banked, and a fill bar along its foot shows how close the next Break Camp is. A NEW DRIVE METER sits beside it — the plate says how much Momentum you HAVE, the meter says how fast the column is building it and what the current turn is about to do to that rate. One pip per unit that still owes a move: fill them all and the trajectory climbs (green), leave any unfilled and it halves (red), so the cost of leaving one unit standing is visible BEFORE you end the turn. THE TITLE PLAQUE is larger and lifted clear of the panel beneath it.
